subject: Benchmark architecture deep-dive & slot coordination with BrightCart
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@brightcart.com>

Cc: BrightCart - Ops <ops@brightcart.com>
Date: 2027-10-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Benchmark deep-dive request — throughput & latency targets

Hi Sofia,

Quick note from BrightCart ops — we're close to the architecture cutover and need a short technical deep-dive to align on the performance plan for our pilot. High level: we want to validate token throughput and 99th percentile latency under our guided traffic shape. Target goals: sustained 18k tokens/sec (aggregate) and p99 < 450ms for 1k token requests.

Can Redwood run a 60–90 minute architecture + runbook walkthrough and reserve a loadtest slot next week? Prefer afternoons in PDT. Also, can you confirm any prerequisites (S3 paths, model pins, prompt sets) so we can prep?

Attaching a sample token distribution and our current test config (loadtest-config-v3.xlsx).

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Director of SRE, BrightCart
samir@brightcart.com

--

Date: 2027-10-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Benchmark deep-dive request — throughput & latency targets

Hi Samir — thanks for the detail and the config. Happy to run this session and block a load test slot.

Pre-reqs from our side:
- A shared read-only S3 or HTTPS endpoint with your prompt corpus and sample responses.
- Confirmation of model family + quantization preference (we usually test both fp16 and int8 variants).
- Desired concurrency pattern: steady-state QPS vs spikes (you mentioned "guided traffic shape" — can you share the CSV).
- Any IP allowlist entries for our test runners.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu Oct 14, 10:00–11:30
- Fri Oct 15, 15:00–16:30

Marcus will own the load generator and runbook. Laura will send a formal invite once we lock the time. If either slot works for you, we’ll drop the calendar invite and the run-of-show.

Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Benchmark deep-dive request — throughput & latency targets

Samir / Sofia — quick technical addendum from the perf team. If BrightCart is targeting ~18k tokens/sec aggregate and p99 < 450ms at 1k tokens, here are our needs and suggestions: 

Minimum infra we want reserved for the slot:
- 4 x A800 nodes (or equivalent) behind our serving pool for the load window
- Dedicated KV cache enabled with a warm prefix cache for the prompt corpus
- Model pin: redwood/gptq-v2-22B (we'll also run a quant comparison if you want int8)

Pre-flight checklist (send prior to test):
- S3 URL: s3://brightcart-bench/prompts/ (CSV)
- Sample traffic CSV (distinguishing token length buckets)
- Peak concurrency target (e.g., 200 concurrent requests)
- Any throttle quotas we should respect for BrightCart origin keys

If you prefer Fri 10/15 at 15:00 PT, I can reallocate the nodes and run the pre-warm the evening before (10/14 19:00 PT). Otherwise Thu 10/14 10:00 PT works too.

Marcus Lin
Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
